Tredjepartsfiler som er lagt lokalt i repoet (ingen eksterne CDN-er):
- plotly-basic.min.js: Plotly.js 2.35.2 (basic), MIT-lisens, https://github.com/plotly/plotly.js
- ../fonts/inter-*.woff2: Inter, SIL Open Font License 1.1, https://github.com/rsms/inter (pakket via @fontsource/inter 5.3.0)
- ../fonts/cormorant-garamond-*.woff2: Cormorant Garamond, SIL Open Font License 1.1, https://github.com/CatharsisFonts/Cormorant (pakket via @fontsource/cormorant-garamond 5.3.0)
